subject: Overrun adjustment & credit timeline for May spike
messages:
From: Sarah Lee <sarah@astratech.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected May overrun — request for breakdown

Hi Tessa,

We just closed our month and saw a substantial overrun vs. our committed capacity for May (about 42% above forecast). Finance asked for a line-item breakdown and a proposal for how Redwood suggests we settle the one-off charge and avoid surprises for June.

Two quick asks:
- Can you share the token/hour breakdown by model variant (gpt-large vs. gag-quant) for May 3–9 spike?
- What flexibility do you have for spreading a one-time adjustment across invoices? We've got internal PO timing constraints.

I pulled a CSV (attached) with our internal consumption mapping — happy to sync, but we need a written proposal to present to our procurement team by Friday.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Lee
Head of Finance Ops
AstraTech

Attachment: astratech_may_usage_summary.csv (CSV, 48KB)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah@astratech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected May overrun — request for breakdown

Hi Sarah — thanks for the heads up and for attaching your mapping. We've pulled our side of the billing data and validated the spike was driven by a three-day testing window where AstraTech routed significant batch inference through the dedicated pool (May 4–6).

Proposal (high level):
- One-time overage invoice: $27,450 (covers the delta from committed capacity to actual usage for May).
- Credit: we propose a one-time 10% service credit applied to June invoice if AstraTech signs the attached amendment to increase committed capacity by 15% starting July 1.
- Payment flexibility: we can split the one-time invoice into two equal invoices (June 10 and July 10) to accommodate PO timing; no additional fees.

I've attached a proposed adjustment statement and a draft amendment. Ben and I can walk procurement through the breakdown — Ben, can you add the per-model token/hour table as a supplementary CSV?

Next step: If this approach looks acceptable, I can generate a DocuSign packet for signature and mark the June invoice to reflect the split.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_adjustment_statement_20270512.pdf (PDF, 56KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah@astratech.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected May overrun — request for breakdown

Thanks Sarah — attached is the per-model and per-day breakdown you requested.

Key notes from finance:
- Line items show the majority of incremental cost came from long-sequence decode runs (gpt-large-16k).
- We calculated the overage at list rate minus your committed discount; the net is $27,450.
- If AstraTech confirms a July start for the +15% commit, we'll apply the 10% credit on the June invoice once the amendment is fully executed.

I can change the invoice cadence to split into two equal amounts with separate invoice numbers. Please confirm PO numbers or if AstraTech prefers Redwood to issue two invoices to the same PO.

Ben Carter
Senior Billing Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: rdw_astratech_model_breakdown_may2027.csv (CSV, 22KB)

From: Sarah Lee <sarah@astratech.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, AstraTech Finance <finance@astratech.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 11:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected May overrun — request for breakdown

Thanks — this is helpful. A few clarifying items from procurement:
- We cannot accept a single invoice > $15k without a second approval step. Splitting into two invoices is acceptable.
- Can you confirm the proposed June invoice split dates (June 10 and July 10) and whether the first invoice will be due on receipt?
- For the 10% credit: procurement requires the amendment to be executed before the credit posts — can DocuSign be sent today so legal has time to review?

If you can confirm the two invoice numbers and send the DocuSign bundle today, procurement will advance the PO review and get us over the finish line.

—Sarah

2) DocuSign: Attached is the amendment packet and the adjustment statement. DocuSign link (embedded): https://docusign.net/embeddedSigning/abc123 — I've set signers: AstraTech Legal (you) and Redwood Sales (me).
